card.name: Words just before a dose number
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right before a number or dose comparison, mostly in animal-study dose multiples such as 'times the human dose' or 'at 40 mg/kg/day'. Also fires on a few similar spots before a figure or date.

modes.label: Dose multiples
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'maximum' after 'times' when a dose is compared with the human dose.
modes.example: sperm count in mice at doses 10 times<< the>> human therapeutic dose; 1 a reduced

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space token just before a dose, duration or percentage figure.
modes.example: 6 month hamster study at<< >>40 mg/kg/day, and in

modes.label: Other comparison words
modes.description: Verbs or 'to' in risk comparisons in general health text.
modes.example: 5 times the risk of mouth and pharynx cancers compared<< to>> people who never drank

card.writes: No clear link to the health words it suppresses; it seems to hold back 'health' words after comparison phrases.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose amount or a comparison like 'times the human dose'.
